tasks.title: Scope builder: exclusions in code → Moss candidates → Jev yes/no → scope, with living updates
tasks.note: Deny-by-default enforced in code before any search: excluded groups and labels leave the pool before Moss or Jev see anything (allowedByRule in server/src/scopes.ts), scopes are fixed fact-id lists, agents are capped at their creator, living updates keep scopes current (4576d07). Expiring clearances were cut by the scopes PRD #14 — access changes are rule edits, not timed grants.

tasks.title: Handoff: search inside the scope → Jev relevance → token budget → audit
tasks.note: server/src/scopes.ts runHandoff: fixed scope → retriever inside the scope's groups with in-code fact-id re-check → inject-nothing judge() check → one batched Jev relevance ask → budget cut in code → audit row with exactly the facts sent. Judge/retriever failures degrade to profile-only, never a refusal or leak. Offline providers are the labelled keyword retriever + fake judge (Moss id-filter and Jev creds still open under A4/Q2).
